{{Quote|Kessel has always been ''last'' on my list of places in the galaxy I'd like to see.|[[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]]|<ref name="The Glove of Darth Vader">''[[The Glove of Darth Vader]]''</ref>}}
'''Kessel''', originally known as '''Xo's Eye''' while under [[Xim's empire]], was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Kessel sector/Legends|Kessel sector]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], and was near the dangerous celestial bodies of [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]]. It was a prison world, and was home to [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] largest [[Glitterstim/Legends|glitterstim]] [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Spice mines of Kessel/Legends|mining operation]]. Under Imperial rule, [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] labor was in extensive use.

The planet was close to [[Little Kessel]] and had a single [[Garrison Moon|moon]], which was destroyed by [[Tol Sivron]] using the [[Death Star prototype]].

==Description==
[[File:Kessel_SWCCG.png|thumb|left|200px|Kessel and the Garrison Moon]]
{{Quote|Yeah, it looks great from up here. Too bad it's so different when you get a closer look. I never liked the place.|Han Solo|<ref name="Jedi Search">''[[Jedi Search]]''</ref>}}
The misshapen [[Planet/Legends|planet]] known as Kessel had a barren, rocky landscape. The atmosphere was very thin, with most of the air being provided by factories on the surface. Ancient tombs and ruins, possibly of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] origin, dotted the landscape, haunted by skeletal avians. The prison had been established in these inhospitable settings. There was a single large settlement on the planet, [[Kessendra]].

==History==
{{Quote|Fear is as much a part of life on Kessel as spice or air. Control it and you'll do fine.|Myda Forge|<ref name="X-Wing: Wedge's Gamble">''[[X-Wing: Wedge's Gamble]]''</ref>}}
During the time of [[Xim's empire]], it was known as Xo's Eye.<ref name="TEA" /> Kessel was the only source of [[Glitterstim/Legends|glitterstim]] spice, a valuable drug used both therapeutically and recreationally. During the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] time, the prison was administered by the [[Colicoid/Legends|Colicoids]].

Sometime during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Hawk Carrow]] and [[Nagraoao]] were prisoners in the [[Spice mines of Kessel/Legends|Spice Mines of Kessel]]. [[Roark Garnet/Legends|Roark Garnet]] took his ship, the ''[[Dorion Discus]]'', to the [[Kessel system/Legends|Kessel system]] to rescue his friends, but was stopped by a [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] for inspection. Garnet bribed the Navy officer to let him go.<ref name="TRG1-">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref>

Later, the prison was [[Kessel Mining Authority|controlled]] by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Warden/Legends|Warden]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Dewt Kluskine]]. Several prisoners rose to positions of power under him as trustees. The most powerful of these was [[Moruth Doole]], who gained effective control of the spice trade by manipulating the Warden's accounts. Doole engineered the assassination of Kluskine by a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] prisoner named [[Gyylghrard]], and eventually seized control of the mines himself.

<div style="float:right">[[File:Kessel_base.jpg|thumb|left|150px|The surface of Kessel]]</div>
The Galactic Republic administered programs to educate inmates on how to re-enter society upon release. Prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Kassar Forge]] was one such teacher in this program. Even after the inmates took control of the planet, he voluntarily remained on the moon, eventually marrying [[Myda Forge|Myda]], one of the former inmates, and having multiple sons and daughters, including future [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] [[Lujayne Forge|Lujayne]] and [[Inyri Forge|Inyri]].

===Imperial period===
{{Quote|Lord Vader, our spies report that Jedi are gathering on Kessel&mdash;tomorrow.|An unidentified Clone trooper to Darth Vader|<ref name="Purge" />}}
Shortly after the execution of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], a small [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Conclave on Kessel|conclave]] was called in one of the [[Unidentified Kessel spice mine|abandoned mines]] of Kessel by [[Shadday Potkin/Legends|Shadday Potkin]] in a futile attempt to lure [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] into a deathtrap. The plan ultimately failed, and all the Jedi who attended were killed.<ref name="Purge" />

===Galactic Civil War===
{{Quote|We'll be sent to the spice mines of Kessel, or smashed into who knows what!|C-3PO|<ref name="Episode 4">{{Film|IV}}</ref>}}
Prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] staged a bold raid there to rescue POWs from the spice mines.<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

[[Tyber Zann]] was another prisoner here, but he escaped during a prison revolt he caused, thanks to his lieutenant [[Urai Fen]].<ref name="FOC">''[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption]]''</ref>

[[File:Kessel_Miners.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Slave spice miners]]

In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], the Imperials kept several massive communication satellites in orbit to maintain control over the prisons, to permit passage through the system, and to coordinate ship landings. One of these satellites was guarded with a [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]], two [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ships]], two [[Tartan-class patrol cruiser|''Tartan''-class patrol cruisers]], and multiple squadrons of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]], [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE interceptors]], and [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bombers]], and a single squadron of elite [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE defenders]].<ref name="FOC" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption}}
The [[Zann Consortium/Legends|Zann Consortium]] had an opportunity to corrupt this spice world by destroying a communications satellite with [[IG-88A/Legends|IG-88]], two [[Crusader-class corvette|''Crusader''-class corvettes]], two [[Vengeance-class frigate|''Vengeance''-class frigates]], and four full squadrons of [[StarViper-class attack platform/Legends|''StarViper''-class starfighters]].<ref name="FOC" />
{{Endgame}}

Admiral [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]] almost became a new inmate at the prisons on Kessel after he was captured by [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] and turned over to the Imperials. Over Kessel, however, the [[Unidentified Imperial-class Star Destroyer (Kessel)|Star Destroyer]] that Ackbar was being held upon was [[Battle of Kessel (0 ABY)|intercepted]] by the elite [[Renegade Squadron/Legends|Renegade Squadron]], commanded by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Col Serra]]. The squadron fought their way through [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]] and numerous [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] aboard the Star Destroyer to rescue Ackbar, which they did successfully.<ref name="BF:RS">''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Renegade Squadron]]''</ref>

During the Galactic Civil War, [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] became a prisoner and slave at one of the Empire's [[Spice/Legends|Spice]] mines, after being [[Assault on Kile II|captured]] near the Imperial [[Enclave]] on [[Kile II]]. He was scheduled for termination, and was being transported by train to a death camp, but the timely [[Rescue on Kessel|intervention]] of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] allowed him to make a last-minute escape. The Rogues then joined with Rebel [[General/Legends|General]] [[Crix Madine/Legends|Crix Madine]] and a task force of [[Commando/Legends|commandos]], who used Antilles's knowledge of the prison camps to quickly rescue a large percentage of the slaves working for the Imperials.<ref name="SW:RSI">[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron (video game)|''Star Wars: Rogue Squadron'']]</ref>

[[CR90 corvette/Legends|Kesselian blockade runners]] participated in the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] as part of the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]].<ref name="Bakura Sourcebook">''[[The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook]]''</ref>

After the Empire lost the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the Imperials on Kessel decided to abandon the planetoid. The [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] factories were shut off, although the prisoners at [[Detention Center A]], [[Detention Center B]], and [[Detention Center C]] were forced to keep working in the thinning air. Shortly after a [[Liberation of Kashyyyk/Legends|liberation]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], Han Solo, [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], and other Wookiee soldiers [[Liberation of Kessel|arrived]] on the planet and successfully re-powered three atmosphere factories, and in the process, freed many of the slaves.<ref name="SW:GB" />

<div style="float:right">[[File:Kessel_battle.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A skirmish at Kessel during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]]]</div>
Kessendra was administered by [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Bertroff Hissa]], and was known for its grandiose coliseum. After the Battle of Endor, Hissa set up the mutant [[Trioculus]] as the new Emperor,<ref name="Jedi Prince" /> in opposition to [[Ysanne Isard]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. He was defeated by the unintentionally combined efforts of Isard and [[Senate Planetary Intelligence Network|SPIN]].

Some time after the death of Trioculus, the staff of the [[Kessel prison|Imperial Correctional Facility]] led by the prison's administrator, [[Moruth Doole]], revolted against the Imperial garrison, overthrowing the guards and taking control of the planet, installing [[Arb Skynxnex]] as his number two. After the revolt, Doole discovered a dead [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]] in the prison which obviously hadn't been fed. He regretted the death of the rancor as he planned to feed the Imperials to it. Instead, he sent them to the mines but tortured the former head of the prison and froze him in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]], displaying it in his office.

The commissioner and his guards kept more than half of the planet under their control until [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]]. During this period, the planet was defended by squadrons of TIE fighters, [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]], [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]], [[Lancer-class frigate/Legends|''Lancer''-class frigates]], [[Carrack-class light cruiser/Legends|''Carrack''-class cruisers]] and various other craft. During this period, Han Solo and Chewbacca arrived to talk about the idea of Kessel joining the New Republic, but were captured and sent to the spice mines, instead. With the help of the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|force-sensitive]] [[Kyp Durron]], the trio escaped from the planet and into the Maw.<ref name="Jedi Search" /> Eventually, Doole and Skynxnex were killed and the planet fell to the [[Smugglers' Alliance]], led by [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]], who later sold it to [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]]. A group of Imperials from the nearby [[Maw Installation]] [[Battle of Kessel (11 ABY)|attempted]] to test the [[Superlaser/Legends|superlaser]] of the Death Star prototype on Kessel, but missed, due to the weapon's poor calibration and hit the Garrison Moon, instead.<ref name="CotF">''[[Champions of the Force]]''</ref>

===New Republic era===
[[File:Eaw_Kessel.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Another view of Kessel]]
Under the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], the planet had no slaves.<ref name="CotF" /> A legitimate spice mining business was run by [[Nien Nunb/Legends|Nien Nunb]], who was installed as administrator around [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]] by Calrissian. Mara Jade was also involved with running Calrissian's business, at least for a time. Calrissian made a substantial initial investment of new equipment and extensively revamped the facilities. Nunb also employed species that, like his own [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] race, preferred to be underground, such as [[craniopod]]s, blind, sentient insectoids who thrived in the underground tunnels and had developed a community in abandoned glitterstim tunnels. The initial investment and Numb's deft administration resulted in happy workers, who proudly made the spice mines a profitable and productive industrial facility.<ref name="Crisis at Crystal Reef">''[[Young Jedi Knights: Crisis at Crystal Reef]]''</ref>

During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the planet was [[Battle of the Kessel system|conquered]] by the [[Yuuzhan Vong|invaders]].<ref name="TEA" />

Kessel was also rumored to be a chunk of rock from the Maw Installation before the Maw was created. No proof has been given to this connection.

On recent expeditions of uncharted tunnels (due to quakes tearing the rock apart), Han and Leia had [[Mission to save Kessel|discovered]] a vast cavern the size of a city filled with fungi stalks, one- to two-meter-long centipedes, crimson-colored spiders that ate fungi and small avian creatures much like miniature [[Hawk-bat/Legends|Hawk-bats]]. This cavern also had gigantic blocks of manufactured equipment, and Leia later discovered the [[Bogey]]s would transfer data from these blocks to an unknown destination. Han and Leia believed that the machinery inside Kessel was created by the [[Celestial/Legends|Celestials]].<ref name="Outcast" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Kessel.jpg|200px|thumb|Kessel as it appeared in ''Jump to Lightspeed'']]
The first appearance of Kessel in the draft scripts for ''A New Hope'' was as "Kissel" in [[George Lucas]]'s notes accompanying the ''[[Journal of the Whills, Part I]]'' as a potential name for a planet.<ref name="The Making of Star Wars">''[[The Making of Star Wars: The Definitive Story Behind the Original Film]]''</ref> The "[[Kessil system]]" contained [[Utapau (Kessil system)|Utapau]] in the [[The Star Wars rough draft|rough draft]].<ref name="Rough Draft">{{WebCite|url=https://www.starwarz.com/starkiller/the-star-wars-rough-draft|text=''The Star Wars: Rough Draft''|work=[https://www.starwarz.com/starkiller Starkiller — The Jedi Bendu Script Site]|archivedate=20240601042406}}</ref> The [[Adventures of the Starkiller, Episode I: The Star Wars|second]]<ref name="2nd Draft">{{WebCite|url=https://www.starwarz.com/starkiller/adventures-of-the-starkiller-second-draft|text=Adventures of the Starkiller, Episode I: The Star Wars|archivedate=20240818175509}}</ref> and [[The Star Wars: From The Adventures of Luke Starkiller|third]] drafts mention that a character called Grande Mouff Tarkin commands the [[Kesselian Dragoon]]s.<ref name="3rd Draft">{{WebCite|url=https://www.starwarz.com/starkiller/the-star-wars-from-the-adventures-of-luke-starkiller-third-draft|text=The Star Wars: From The Adventures of Luke Starkiller|archivedate=20240818094359}}</ref> Kessel was mentioned in [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']]. [[Protocol droid/Legends|Protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] feared for himself and his droid counterpart, [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], "We'll be sent to space mines of Kessel." In the revised fourth draft of ''A New Hope'', Han Solo first made a reference to the [[Kessel Run/Legends|Kessel Run]].

Kessel, as depicted in ''[[The Second Kessel Run]]'', was a lush, idyllic world containing the [[Giant Fungi Forest]]. According to ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', and confirmed by Jason Fry on the Jedi Council Forums, this depiction has been [[Retroactive continuity|retconned]] into being [[Little Kessel]], a world not far off the Kessel Run.<ref name="Jason Fry Little Kessel">{{JCFCite|url=posts/30364686|board=Literature|thread=The Essential Atlas and Galactic Cartography: Official Discussion|user=[[Jason Fry|jasonfry]]|date=2009-08-20|time=5:45 AM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20171212045150/http://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-essential-atlas-and-galactic-cartography-official-discussion.21938930/page-90|quote=Yes. A bit of a "Hoth Stuff" style retcon, perhaps, but I thought it worked OK.}}</ref>

In ''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]'' and "[[Star Wars Battlefront: Renegade Squadron]]" Kessel is portrayed as a spherical planet, whereas other official sources portray it as a [[Potato/Legends|potato]]-shaped planet. In ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'', Kessel is mistakenly portrayed as a greenish-blue, lush-looking spherical planet.

[[In-universe]], Kessel is often likened to Hell (for example, the use of "Kesseled" as equivalent to "damned").

In the [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] novel [[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast|''Outcast'']], the Garrison Moon is mentioned as actually being present and used as a base of operations, despite being destroyed by the Death Star prototype years earlier.
